name: Thornfield
worldBackground: Thornfield is a poor farming village of forty souls at the edge of the king's wood: one street, one well, one inn that sees a cart a week. The harvest is in, the tithe barn is half full, and the first frost is late this year. Travellers on the road bring news of trouble in the towns and leave before dark. The forest keeps its own counsel, and the villagers like it that way.

currency.name: Copper penny
currency.description: The small coin of the market towns; four make a silver bit.

narrativeRules: Poverty is specific: count things. One well, one forge, two carts, a known number of chickens.
The forest is ordinary by day and reasonless by night; never explain what lives in it.
Villagers are wary of strangers but bound by hospitality; a shared meal creates obligation.
The lord's reeve visits at Martinmas; the tithe barn is counted, and the count is short.

zones.name: Village Green
zones.description: The whole of Thornfield: a green with a well, four buildings around it, and the road out.

buildings.name: The Green Dragon Inn

zones.name: Millfield

buildings.name: Tithe Barn

zones.name: King's Wood
zones.description: The king's wood: pines deep enough to swallow a road, cut for firewood at the edges and nowhere else.

templates.name: Long bench

templates.name: Clay hearth

templates.name: Oak barrel

rooms.name: Forge

npcs.name: Maribel Dabney
npcs.description: The Green Dragon's keeper: broad, cheerful, and remembers every unpaid ale. Wants a second cart for market days.
npcs.physicalDescription: Stout middle-aged woman, apron, sleeves rolled, ale-soiled towel over one shoulder

npcs.name: Ordwin Blake
npcs.description: The smith: quiet, exact, sleeps by his forge. Owes the reeve a bad debt and knows it.
npcs.physicalDescription: Bare-armed smith with burn-scarred forearms, leather apron, soot in his beard

npcs.name: Tilly Reed
npcs.description: The weaver: quick-tongued, keeps the village's news and its cloth. Sells to the market towns at a fair markup.
npcs.physicalDescription: Thin young woman, yarn-threaded skirt, quick eyes, distaff in hand

player.name: Robin Hale
player.description: A traveller who took the Oak Cottage for the winter: handy with a hoe, cagey about the road behind you.
player.physicalDescription: Lean young traveler, patched wool coat, walking staff, hood down
